# Avery Dennison® Expands Wet-Apply Paint Protection Film Portfolio with 7-Year Clear Film Option at a Smarter Price Point


MENTOR, Ohio – August 26, 2026 – Avery Dennison (NYSE:AVY) Graphics Solutions announced the official launch of[Supreme Defense™ Gloss Lite Paint Protection Film](https://graphics.averydennison.com/en/home/graphics-products/paint-protection-film/supreme-defense-gloss-lite-film.html) , an exceptional 7.5-mil clear PPF engineered to bring high-volume installation versatility and a smarter price point to the Supreme Defense PPF portfolio of films.


Avery Dennison’s new Supreme Defense™ Gloss Lite Paint Protection Film is an exceptional 7.5-mil clear PPF offered as a cost-effective option within the Supreme Defense PPF portfolio of films.


Supreme Defense Gloss Lite PPF by Avery Dennison is a self-healing, hydrophobic film backed by a seven-year warranty.


Designed specifically to keep the vehicles of daily drivers, leased vehicles, and commercial fleets, fully shielded from harsh road hazards, Supreme Defense Gloss Lite is a wet-apply, self-healing, hydrophobic film backed by a seven-year warranty. The film is a dependable choice for shops and installers seeking to expand their paint protection film offering with a competitively priced, optically clear gloss film. The smarter price point of Supreme Defense Gloss Lite enables shops to capture price-sensitive projects and secure high-volume dealership protection programs, improving their efficiency and growing their business.


Shops with significant volume will appreciate Supreme Defense Gloss Lite film clarity, thickness, and stretchability performance consistent with the trusted Avery Dennison brand. With the addition of Supreme Defense Gloss Lite, the company’s popular Supreme Defense portfolio also includes:


- [Supreme Defense Gloss PPF](https://graphics.averydennison.com/en/home/graphics-products/paint-protection-film/supreme-defense-gloss-film.html) – the luxury and premium vehicle standard which offers a 10-year warranty for long-term vehicle preservation.
- [Supreme Defense Matte PPF](https://graphics.averydennison.com/en/home/graphics-products/paint-protection-film/supreme-defense-matte-film.html) – the sophisticated styling standard with a seven-year warranty and a custom matte finish.


“The paint protection film industry is evolving, and Avery Dennison is expanding with it,” said Brittany Folino, Senior Product Manager for Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions. “Our latest film innovation allows installers to deliver strong rock chip defense and high visual appeal for price-conscious customers and high-volume dealership protection programs. It offers a smarter entry point for growing installers entering the PPF market, giving them full brand credibility and plotter-friendly efficiency at a price point that fits their expanding business. As we continue to innovate and expand our film offerings, we are taking into account the real-world needs of the aftermarket marketplace and the growth goals of today's installers. ”


For more technical specifications about Supreme Defense Gloss Lite Paint Protection Film, visit visit[graphics.averydennison.com/ppf](https://graphics.averydennison.com/en/home/graphics-products/paint-protection-film.html) and join the conversation on Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions’ social channels, including[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/AveryDennisonGraphics/) and[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/adgraphics_na/?hl=en) .
